about: Geo intent shared by apps/api/app/modules/web_search/{patterns,geo_intent}.py (with is_location_question in app/services/time_context.py) and apps/mobile/lib/localPlacesQuery.ts, which the phone runs before sending to decide whether to read GPS. Both test suites ask every reader about every case: `reads` lists the readers that say yes, and every other reader must say no. Change a rule on both sides and update these cases in the same change. The composite is_geo_query is not held here: the server adds a local-weather ask, the phone a where-am-I ask.

rules.distance_intent: _DISTANCE_INTENT: how far, driving time, directions to. A fixed A-to-B distance (distance between, distance from the sun) names its own origin and needs no GPS unless the origin is the user (_FROM_USER).
rules.motion_homework: _MOTION_HOMEWORK: a how-far or how-long question about acceleration, launches, speeds, levers, lenses, mirrors or echoes is physics homework, not a trip from the user.
rules.trip_how_many: _HOW_MANY_ASKED / _TRIP_PLACE / _TRIP_NAMED_PLACE: how many minutes, miles or km is a trip only beside where it goes or starts, or away; otherwise it is a duration or a length.
rules.location_question: is_location_question (app/services/time_context.py): the whole message asks where the user is, typos included; a sentence that only starts that way does not.
rules.proximity: _NEARBY_INTENT / _IMPLICIT_LOCAL / best_near_phrase / non_geographic_nearest: near me, nearest, where should we eat. Nearest prime, closest friend or a number line is not a place; the best-in and nearest-word scans look 120 characters ahead, across lines.
rules.ambiguous_places: _AMBIGUOUS_NEARBY_SUBJECT / _QUALIFIED_NEARBY: a nearby home or property ask without sale, rent or an address is clarified before searching.
